doc: match_to_earth(cov, earth, hadley_deg, levels, strength): sigmas 2^k (k < levels) in Earth texels, scaled by the width ratio for the generated map; band_layers of both (float32), each generated layer quantile-matched per latitude zone to the same Earth layer (_match_by_zone, Earth zones from lat at hadley 30 with rows past 67.5 degrees excluded), summed with strength * matched + (1 - strength) * original, plus the matched residual, clipped to [0, 1], then matched once more as a whole to Earth's own map, and blended again by strength; the result is float32. Extra output block_mean8 = float64 means of the 8x8 blocks of `out`, computed by the case: a robust summary that bounds the texels `out` lets differ. Tolerance, measured on 9 runs of the case (8 with cov and Earth moved by -1, 0 or +1 float32 ulp per texel, one with every float32 intermediate promoted to float64, i.e. what a float64 port computes): the layers are float32 band-pass differences and the quantile tables turn tied values (a texel equal to a plateau value is mapped through the 1e-9 ladder) into steep steps, so a few texels move by up to 9e-4 (on average 1e-7) while the 8x8 block means move by <= 1.6e-5. Hence `out`: 1e-5 + 1e-5 |want| for 97% of the texels (the largest fraction outside was 0.33%, frac = 10x = 0.03), block_mean8: 1e-4 + 2e-4 |want|. Cov: the isotropic generated map at 64x32 (8-bit preview), Earth 128x64 (stored u8 / 255), width ratio 0.5. The cov handed to the function is float64 (the u8 map divided by 255 then cast): it is cast to float32 first (cov.astype(np.float32)); the output is float32 all the same. Input convention: the u8 input(s) cov, earth are maps stored as bytes, and the function receives them as float32(u8) / float32(255) (`u8.astype(np.float32) / 255.0`: the division is done, and correctly rounded, in float32, as measure.load reads an 8-bit map), NOT as the raw bytes and NOT as a float64 quotient (a texel on a histogram edge or a threshold would move). params.u8_inputs lists them.

u8_inputs.cov: float32(u8) / float32(255), the division in float32
u8_inputs.earth: float32(u8) / float32(255), the division in float32
